scripts.build: bun run build:backend && bun run build:frontend
scripts.build:frontend: bun run scripts/check-mochi-css.ts && bun build src/frontend.ts --target=browser --format=esm --outfile=dist/frontend.js
scripts.verify: bun run typecheck && bun run build && bun test tests/portal.test.ts tests/domain.test.ts tests/jev.test.ts tests/generation-lifecycle.test.ts tests/tracker-display.test.ts tests/weather-display.test.ts tests/event-invite.test.ts tests/image-jobs.test.ts tests/settings-camera.test.ts tests/touch-scroll.test.ts tests/app-reviews.test.ts tests/activity-connectors.test.ts tests/activity-clock.test.ts tests/voice.test.ts tests/mochi.test.ts tests/mochi-scheduler.test.ts tests/mochi-accounts.test.ts tests/mochi-profiles.test.ts tests/mochi-phone-selection.test.ts tests/mochi-assignment.test.ts tests/mochi-auto-replies.test.ts tests/mochi-scheduling-lifecycle.test.ts tests/mochi-workspace.test.ts tests/mochi-session.test.ts && node tests/contracts.mjs
scripts.test:mochi: bun test tests/mochi.test.ts tests/mochi-scheduler.test.ts tests/mochi-accounts.test.ts tests/mochi-profiles.test.ts tests/mochi-phone-selection.test.ts tests/mochi-assignment.test.ts tests/mochi-auto-replies.test.ts tests/mochi-scheduling-lifecycle.test.ts tests/mochi-workspace.test.ts tests/mochi-session.test.ts
scripts.build:legacy: bun build src/backend-legacy.ts --target=bun --format=esm --outfile=tmp/legacy-dist/backend.js && bun build src/frontend-legacy.ts --target=browser --format=esm --outfile=tmp/legacy-dist/frontend.js
